liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (3 reviews): Reviewer singles out the Dark Star as a standout and the main reason to hear the show; Reviewer, who lives 35 minutes away, calls Dark Star a lifetime highlight [22][24][27]
- **I Know You Rider** (2 reviews): Hornsby plays wildly during Rider, adding extra energy; reviewer ranks the China>Rider among the best; Jerry and Bruce jam hard on Rider, giving the reviewer chills [22][26]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Jerry's guitar was off for roughly the first two-thirds of the opener [30]
- **Just Like Tom Thumb's Blues** (1 review): Reviewer stood about ten feet from Phil during Tom Thumb's Blues [25]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Bird Song soaring [22]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Echo machine effects on Looks Like Rain after China>Rider are praised [30]

## The recordings

- **gd1991-04-01.168446.Greensboro.NC.sbd.cm.miller.t-flac1648** (recommended): soundboard; 18 songs; 157 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1991-04-01.149666.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 158 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1991-04-01.137352.SBD.PCM.Gans.Minches.Miller.fixed.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 161 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1991-04-01.168442.Greensboro.NC.Ultramatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t-flac1648**: soundboard; 18 songs; 158 min [6]
- **gd91-04-01.sbd.connor.9732.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 144 min; rated 4.46/5 by 37 [17]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds it a beautiful copy that keeps the echoes and effects heard from the floor; Reviewer describes the sound of this recording as pristine; Reviewer rates the sound five stars [23][24][30][31][32]

## Around the show

- Reviewer stood on the floor, second row, at this show [23]
- Crowd around the reviewer seemed transformed into Hobbit characters when the opening notes began [24]
- Reviewer got a front row ticket from the Grateful Dead Office [25]
- Reviewer and another solo front-row fan brought several friends down front for the second set [25]
- Reviewer attended both Greensboro shows and found them outstanding [33]
- Reviewer counts this China>Rider among favorites and credits Bruce with energizing the band; wishes he'd stayed longer [26]
- Reviewer says Hornsby revived a tired band, especially Garcia [27]
- Reviewer calls it among the best of Spring 1991, perhaps best for performance and song choice [32]
- Reviewer thinks this Greensboro run is hard to beat among nineties shows, except spring 1990 Hamilton or Nassau [33]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1991-04-01.168446.Greensboro.NC.sbd.cm.miller.t-flac1648**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  April 5, 2023; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [1]. Also: An earlier source ran almost 2% fast, so the transfer was redone instead of pitch-corrected [1]
- **gd1991-04-01.149666.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  April 22 2020; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [2]. Also: Multiple sets of masters were combined to make the show complete [2]
- **gd1991-04-01.137352.SBD.PCM.Gans.Minches.Miller.fixed.flac16**: taped by David Gans; transferred by Charlie Miller and David Minches; source: Recording Info: SBD > Dat Master > PCM; Transfer Info: PCM (Sony SL-HF500) > Sony PCM601-ESD > Omega Fenix HT > Audio Audition 6.0 > FLAC; Mastering Info: FLAC… [3]. Also: This is a fixed version of an earlier release, repairing a dropout in Peggy-O [3]
- **gd1991-04-01.168442.Greensboro.NC.Ultramatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t-flac1648**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  April 5, 2024; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [6]. Also: Tape warble in the Dark Star track was fixed; Multiple sets of masters were used to make the show complete [6]
- **gd91-04-01.sbd.connor.9732.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>DAT>CDR (Musicfan's seed to abgd; Secondary Source provides d1t01-t04; the last 5 seconds of d1t07;the last 2:01 of d1t09; CD Remastering by Charlie… [17]. Also: Reviewer guesses the master went to digital, then back to analog to boost a low signal; The first couple of tracks come from a different source than most of the show; see the text file [31][32]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by gdnotebook.blogspot.com: [1991-03-31 - Greensboro Coliseum](https://gdnotebook.blogspot.com/2011/07/1991-03-31-greensboro-coliseum.html) [35]
- Poster by Michael: [1991-04-01 Greensboro Coliseum, Greensboro, NC, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1991-04-01-greensboro-coliseum-greensboro-nc-usa/) [36]

claims.text: Reviewer calls the Bird Song soaring
Hornsby plays wildly during Rider, adding extra energy; reviewer ranks the China>Rider among the best
Reviewer singles out the Dark Star as a standout and the main reason to hear the show
Reviewer finds it a beautiful copy that keeps the echoes and effects heard from the floor
Reviewer stood on the floor, second row, at this show
Reviewer, who lives 35 minutes away, calls Dark Star a lifetime highlight
Crowd around the reviewer seemed transformed into Hobbit characters when the opening notes began
Reviewer describes the sound of this recording as pristine
Reviewer got a front row ticket from the Grateful Dead Office
Reviewer stood about ten feet from Phil during Tom Thumb's Blues
Reviewer and another solo front-row fan brought several friends down front for the second set
Jerry and Bruce jam hard on Rider, giving the reviewer chills
Reviewer counts this China>Rider among favorites and credits Bruce with energizing the band; wishes he'd stayed longer
Reviewer names this the best Dark Star of the nineties, a masterpiece of the later years
Reviewer says Hornsby revived a tired band, especially Garcia
Reviewer rates the sound five stars
Jerry's guitar was off for roughly the first two-thirds of the opener
Echo machine effects on Looks Like Rain after China>Rider are praised
Reviewer hears oversaturation in some frequencies, especially vocals, and squashed stereo imaging
Reviewer guesses the master went to digital, then back to analog to boost a low signal
Noticeable tape hiss in quieter passages
Reviewer calls it among the best of Spring 1991, perhaps best for performance and song choice
Sound is decent but less crisp than many other 1991 soundboards on the archive
The first couple of tracks come from a different source than most of the show; see the text file
Reviewer attended both Greensboro shows and found them outstanding
Reviewer thinks this Greensboro run is hard to beat among nineties shows, except spring 1990 Hamilton or Nassau
An earlier source ran almost 2% fast, so the transfer was redone instead of pitch-corrected
Multiple sets of masters were combined to make the show complete
This is a fixed version of an earlier release, repairing a dropout in Peggy-O
Tape warble in the Dark Star track was fixed
